name: atomic.claim
description: single-field judgment: is the ITEM CLAIM one verifiable fact? State = the claim text ONLY. Sibling of ultra.proof (same prompt), whose multi-part state the judge cannot separate (UltraPlan V2 W04 finding 2026-09-20: the same claim scored 0.48 inside a claim+test+evidence blob and 0.88 alone). One question, one field: no separation problem is even possible.

claim_atomic.instructions: This claim states one verifiable thing rather than several bundled together

rules.reason: compound claim cannot be verified or falsified as written: split it

notes.claim_atomic: prompt copied verbatim from ultra.proof so corpus transfers
